issues.explanation: Chapter 60 ends by depicting刘备已经分兵、率五万大军西行，且孟达已率五千人前来迎接；Chapter 61 then returns to“第二天”刘备与刘璋宴饮，发生舞剑冲突，之后才因张鲁来犯前往葭萌关。这 makes the handoff appear to move backward in time.
issues.suggested_fix: End Chapter 60 before the actual departure, after刘备 rejects the first assassination proposal, or move the troop-division,廖化来降、孟达迎接和西行段落 to after the Chapter 61 banquet sequence and before刘备前往葭萌关.
